author: CNET
description:
Deepfakes aren't just poorly generated AI videos anymore. Some of them can be really convincing audio clips, emails, and more. CNET reporter Katelyn Chedraoui spoke with experts about the newest wave of AI voicemail scams and even tried to see if she could fool her sister with an AI voice deepfake. Check out the full video on YouTube.
